description: Get the normalized pipeline status (running | succeeded | failed) for one content row, plus the raw stage behind it. Read-only. Poll once per contentId returned by create_content (content.pipeline.start). A stage of generated_brief with status running means the brief is ready and waiting — for a non-auto-approve draft it stays there until approve_brief is called, so do not treat running as always in progress. Not meaningful for tracked pages (track_content_urls / external rows): they have no generation pipeline and report running with a null stage forever — read them via get_tracked_content or get_content_detail instead.
name: get_content_status
